sprint_target.description: Narrative similarity vs institutional research must be >= 75%

note: Similarity is computed via keyword overlap between Agent expected narrative and institutional research summary. Full automated comparison would require NLP embedding similarity (BERT/SentenceTransformer) which is beyond scope of this sprint. Current method provides directional guidance.
